mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as observed across historical monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest quartile is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in recession risk.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises >0.2pp and RSAFS falls >0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (UNRATE change * RSAFS change) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as higher discount rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with FEDFUNDS rising, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day returns in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as reduced output lowers corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 110.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 (thousands of units) signals weakening residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as the market reacts to housing sector slowdown.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1000.0, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 138,000 (thousands of persons) signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as higher consumer spending boosts corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 138,000, or the Rank IC between PAYEMS and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) compresses supply chain capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as reduced output lowers corporate earnings expectations across multiple sectors.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 10-year median, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
